claims.passCondition: An exact instance reaches the human-decision gate only when every requested action, authority, data use, lifecycle effect, budget, evidence requirement, trigger, stop condition, and declared time window is within the standing policy.
claims.primarySurface: 73-case focused selftest with exact normalization, deterministic rebuild, and scope-expansion adversaries
claims.secondarySurface: closed JSON schemas, permissionless TEST module contract, and standalone output normalizer
claims.counterevidence: Any widened instance reaches the hold-free status or any forged staged truth normalizes.

claims.passCondition: The ordered roots are immutable and the code-domain instance binds exactly one policy-bound four-root review schema before the human gate.
claims.primarySurface: root-order and pre-decision evidence schema-set adversarial tests
claims.secondarySurface: module contract, README boundary, and policy schema
claims.counterevidence: Reordered roots or substituted pre-decision evidence reaches the human gate.
claims.namedSeam: The referenced review content still needs verification by its native verifier before a human decision.

claims.passCondition: Mandatory re-consent triggers and stop conditions cannot be omitted, and instance triggers exactly match the policy.
claims.primarySurface: normalizer rejection and deterministic hold tests
claims.counterevidence: A proposal can omit revocation, drift, expiry, budget, evidence, or safety stopping behavior.

claims.passCondition: A future hardware-domain proposal can be structurally bounded while domain safety, host authority, and hardware actuation remain false.
claims.primarySurface: focused cross-domain hardware case and truth-ceiling assertions
claims.secondarySurface: contract refusals and terminal next-gate text
claims.counterevidence: A matching hardware policy is reported as safety proof or actuation authority.
claims.namedSeam: No device, sensor, interlock, operator-presence, telemetry, or emergency-stop verifier exists.

claims.passCondition: All earlier Fabric suites and sealed receipt selftests pass without rewriting their pinned surfaces.
claims.primarySurface: five Fabric suites and five historical receipt selftests
claims.secondarySurface: additive-only Git diff against v1.7 tip
claims.counterevidence: Historical byte drift or any focused regression remains.

claims.passCondition: An admitted human decision identity authenticates the exact instance and a denied identity is refused.
claims.counterevidence: No admitted human decision-key policy or decision verifier exists.

claims.passCondition: Immediately before an attempt, a trusted clock and current revocation state show the consent is active.
claims.counterevidence: The evaluator accepts a declared timestamp and performs no live state observation.

claims.passCondition: A separately authorized repaired executor runs under measured disposable isolation and emits bounded receipts.
claims.counterevidence: Supplied runtimes remained data and no executor was authorized.

claims.passCondition: Only applicable when a visual or interactive decision surface changes.
claims.counterevidence: No visual or browser surface changed.
